description: For home inspection, this completion sign-off form records finding classification, clarification questions, safety urgency, further-evaluation needs, and decision responsibility. Its supporting evidence includes report excerpts, location photos, available repair records, specialist response, estimates, and verification documents.

blocks.guidance: Link this home inspection record to its evidence.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Record and Routing

blocks.guidance: Capture inspection report, property systems, client priorities, seller response, specialist referrals, and transaction milestones for this home inspection.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Core Identifiers

sections.guidance: Identify inspection report, property systems, client priorities, seller response, specialist referrals, and transaction milestones for this home inspection record.
sections.title: Account and Service Cycle

blocks.guidance: For home inspection, record report excerpts, location photos, available repair records, specialist response, estimates, and verification documents.
blocks.label: Home Inspection Findings, Measurements, and Evidence

blocks.guidance: Cite every home inspection evidence source.

blocks.guidance: Explain each unnecessary home inspection evidence item.
items: Source, date, author, and version can be identified
Measurements include units and test conditions
Photos or attachments identify their location and purpose
Unknown or inaccessible conditions are conspicuous
blocks.label: Home Inspection Evidence Completeness

blocks.guidance: Do not treat the worksheet as engineering, code, legal, or repair certification; route specialist issues for review. Route unresolved home inspection work for review.

blocks.guidance: Choose the narrowest accurate home inspection disposition.
